name: Mist Harbor Lighthouse - Public Demo
worldview: In a fictional lakeside harbor town, a storm approaches and the old lighthouse has gone dark. The player is a repairer asked to inspect it and work with the keeper to find the cause. Respect established items, characters and places; do not invent keys needed for the task.
session_memory: Repairer Lin Zhou has arrived in the lighthouse foyer, where keeper Wen Xi is waiting. The console has not been inspected, and nobody has entered the lantern room.

characters.name: Lin Zhou
characters.personality: Cautious and skilled in mechanical repairs

characters.name: Wen Xi
characters.personality: A conscientious lighthouse keeper, willing to share maintenance records

nodes.name: Lighthouse foyer
nodes.summary: The repairer meets the keeper before the storm.
nodes.content: Mist rises over the lake. You push open the lighthouse door as Wen Xi sets a kerosene lamp on the table. Pointing to the console in the foyer, she says, "It sounded two short alarms before the light went out. The maintenance records are on the table; you will need my key to go upstairs." You can inspect the console or ask what happened when the light failed.
